title: Poor SD-Access fabric health
description: Alerts when the SD-Access fabric health score that Cisco Catalyst Center assigns a fabric node averages 3 or lower over 15 minutes, the poor range of its 1 to 10 scale. A node in poor fabric health can disrupt connectivity and policy for the endpoints and virtual networks that rely on it.
